marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Amir and Loqman, two lowly criminals who are just not cut for the life of crime, resort to trying their hands at robbing money changers upon learning that they must pay a whopping RM30,000 to exit the 'Brotherhood' they were once so badly wanted to join. They now want only one thing - to set up a cafe by the sea and to spend the rest of their days serving drinks to beautiful foreigners! They are oblivious to the fact that the Brotherhood are being hunted and viciously killed by three mysterious assassins. Wll Amir and Loqman manage to escape the Brotherhood ... alive?
